fingerprintReviews.reason: Sidebar is one bounded navigation presentation component: adopted controls for scoped Conversations/action destinations, current-page semantics, labelled disconnected items and local New conversation reset. The new action link and scoped Conversations handler extend that same navigation responsibility; they neither invoke action APIs nor establish client/run/approval authority. Destination data and shared URL helpers already have canonical owners. At112 nonblank function lines, splitting the JSX solely for length would obscure the relationship between active-route state and links without removing an independent reason to change.
